record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> concerning<WH01697> the dearth<WH01226>. <RF>the dearth: Heb. the words of the dearths, or, restraints<Rf>

Judah<WH03063> mourneth<WH056><WTH8804>, and the gates<WH08179> thereof languish<WH0535><WTH8797>; they are black<WH06937><WTH8804> unto the ground<WH0776>; and the cry<WH06682> of Jerusalem<WH03389> is gone up<WH05927><WTH8804>.

And their nobles<WH0117> have sent<WH07971><WTH8804> their little ones<WH06810> to the waters<WH04325>: they came<WH0935><WTH8804> to the pits<WH01356><WTH8676><WH01360>, <FI>and<Fi> found<WH04672><WTH8804> no water<WH04325>; they returned<WH07725><WTH8804> with their vessels<WH03627> empty<WH07387>; they were ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804> and confounded<WH03637><WTH8717>, and covered<WH02645><WTH8804> their heads<WH07218>.

Because the ground<WH0127> is chapt<WH02865><WTH8804>, for there was no rain<WH01653> in the earth<WH0776>, the plowmen<WH0406> were ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804>, they covered<WH02645><WTH8804> their heads<WH07218>.
Yea, the hind<WH0365> also calved<WH03205><WTH8804> in the field<WH07704>, and forsook<WH05800><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> , because there was no grass<WH01877>.

And the wild asses<WH06501> did stand<WH05975><WTH8804> in the high places<WH08205>, they snuffed up<WH07602><WTH8804> the wind<WH07307> like dragons<WH08577>; their eyes<WH05869> did fail<WH03615><WTH8804>, because <FI>there was<Fi> no grass<WH06212>.

O LORD<WH03068>, though our iniquities<WH05771> testify<WH06030><WTH8804> against us, do<WH06213><WTH8798> thou <FI>it<Fi> for thy name's<WH08034> sake: for our backslidings<WH04878> are many<WH07231><WTH8804>; we have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against thee.

O the hope<WH04723> of Israel<WH03478>, the saviour<WH03467><WTH8688> thereof in time<WH06256> of trouble<WH06869>, why shouldest thou be as a stranger<WH01616> in the land<WH0776>, and as a wayfaring man<WH0732><WTH8802> <FI>that<Fi> turneth aside<WH05186><WTH8804> to tarry for a night<WH03885><WTH8800>?

Why shouldest thou be as a man<WH0376> astonied<WH01724><WTH8737>, as a mighty man<WH01368> <FI>that<Fi> cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> save<WH03467><WTH8687>? yet thou, O LORD<WH03068>, <FI>art<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of us, and we are called<WH07121><WTH8738> by thy name<WH08034>; leave<WH03240><WTH8686> us not. <RF>we...: Heb. thy name is called upon us<Rf><CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> unto this people<WH05971>, Thus have they loved<WH0157><WTH8804> to wander<WH05128><WTH8800>, they have not refrained<WH02820><WTH8804> their feet<WH07272>, therefore the LORD<WH03068> doth not accept<WH07521><WTH8804> them; he will now remember<WH02142><WTH8799> their iniquity<WH05771>, and visit<WH06485><WTH8799> their sins<WH02403>.
Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> unto me, Pray<WH06419><WTH8691> not for this people<WH05971> for <FI>their<Fi> good<WH02896>.

When they fast<WH06684><WTH8799>, I will not hear<WH08085><WTH8802> their cry<WH07440>; and when they offer<WH05927><WTH8686> burnt offering<WH05930> and an oblation<WH04503>, I will not accept<WH07521><WTH8802> them: but I will consume<WH03615><WTH8764> them by the sword<WH02719>, and by the famine<WH07458>, and by the pestilence<WH01698>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> I, Ah<WH0162>, Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>! behold, the prophets<WH05030> say<WH0559><WTH8802> unto them, Ye shall not see<WH07200><WTH8799> the sword<WH02719>, neither shall ye have famine<WH07458>; but I will give<WH05414><WTH8799> you assured<WH0571> peace<WH07965> in this place<WH04725>. <RF>assured...: Heb. peace of truth<Rf>

Then the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, The prophets<WH05030> prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> lies<WH08267> in my name<WH08034>: I sent<WH07971><WTH8804> them not, neither have I commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> them, neither spake<WH01696><WTH8765> unto them: they prophesy<WH05012><WTH8693> unto you a false<WH08267> vision<WH02377> and divination<WH07081>, and a thing of nought<WH0457><WTH8675><WH0434>, and the deceit<WH08649> of their heart<WH03820>.

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> concerning the prophets<WH05030> that prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> in my name<WH08034>, and I sent<WH07971><WTH8804> them not, yet they say<WH0559><WTH8802>, Sword<WH02719> and famine<WH07458> shall not be in this land<WH0776>; By sword<WH02719> and famine<WH07458> shall those prophets<WH05030> be consumed<WH08552><WTH8735>.

And the people<WH05971> to whom they prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> shall be cast out<WH07993><WTH8716> in the streets<WH02351> of Jerusalem<WH03389> because<WH06440> of the famine<WH07458> and the sword<WH02719>; and they shall have none to bury<WH06912><WTH8764> them<WH01992>, them, their wives<WH0802>, nor their sons<WH01121>, nor their daughters<WH01323>: for I will pour<WH08210><WTH8804> their wickedness<WH07451> upon them.<CM>

Therefore thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> this word<WH01697> unto them; Let mine eyes<WH05869> run down<WH03381><WTH8799> with tears<WH01832> night<WH03915> and day<WH03119>, and let them not cease<WH01820><WTH8799>: for the virgin<WH01330> daughter<WH01323> of my people<WH05971> is broken<WH07665><WTH8738> with a great<WH01419> breach<WH07667>, with a very<WH03966> grievous<WH02470><WTH8737> blow<WH04347>.

If I go forth<WH03318><WTH8804> into the field<WH07704>, then behold the slain<WH02491> with the sword<WH02719>! and if I enter<WH0935><WTH8804> into the city<WH05892>, then behold them that are sick<WH08463> with famine<WH07458>! yea, both the prophet<WH05030> and the priest<WH03548> go about<WH05503><WTH8804> into a land<WH0776> that they know<WH03045><WTH8804> not. <RF>go about...: or, make merchandise against a land, and men acknowledge it not<Rf>

Hast thou utterly<WH03988><WTH8800> rejected<WH03988><WTH8804> Judah<WH03063>? hath thy soul<WH05315> lothed<WH01602><WTH8804> Zion<WH06726>? why hast thou smitten<WH05221><WTH8689> us, and <FI>there is<Fi>  no healing<WH04832> for us? we looked<WH06960><WTH8763> for peace<WH07965>, and <FI>there is<Fi> no good<WH02896>; and for the time<WH06256> of healing<WH04832>, and behold trouble<WH01205>!
We acknowledge<WH03045><WTH8804>, O LORD<WH03068>, our wickedness<WH07562>, <FI>and<Fi> the iniquity<WH05771> of our fathers<WH01>: for we have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against thee.

Do not abhor<WH05006><WTH8799> <FI>us<Fi> , for thy name's<WH08034> sake, do not disgrace<WH05034><WTH8762> the throne<WH03678> of thy glory<WH03519>: remember<WH02142><WTH8798>, break<WH06565><WTH8686> not thy covenant<WH01285> with us.

Are there<WH03426> <FI>any<Fi> among the vanities<WH01892> of the Gentiles<WH01471> that can cause rain<WH01652><WTH8688>? or can the heavens<WH08064> give<WH05414><WTH8799> showers<WH07241>? <FI>art<Fi>  not thou he, O LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>? therefore we will wait<WH06960><WTH8762> upon thee: for thou hast made<WH06213><WTH8804> all these <FI>things<Fi> .<CM>
